# Tong's Information

> An independent bilingual digital journal crafted directly in HTML by its author and AI agents
> 一份在 AI 时代放下框架、由作者与 Agent 共创的双语独立数字刊物

## Agent Discovery & Machine Endpoints
- Full bilingual corpus: https://www.esoren.com/llms-full.txt
- Structured catalog JSON: https://www.esoren.com/api/posts.json
- Concept topology graph JSON: https://www.esoren.com/api/graph.json
- Stream (fragments) JSON: https://www.esoren.com/api/stream.json
- Stream Markdown twins: https://www.esoren.com/en/stream/index.md | https://www.esoren.com/stream/index.md
- Stream RSS feeds: https://www.esoren.com/en/stream/rss.xml | https://www.esoren.com/stream/rss.xml
- English RSS / JSON Feed: https://www.esoren.com/en/rss.xml | https://www.esoren.com/en/feed.json
- Chinese RSS / JSON Feed: https://www.esoren.com/rss.xml | https://www.esoren.com/feed.json

## Issues (English Markdown Twins)
- [Issue 01 (FEATURE): Let Blogs Be Blogs Again](https://www.esoren.com/en/posts/let-blogs-be-blogs-again/index.md): From middle-school Hexo builds, Baota panels, and Sakurairo themes to a blank sheet of native HTML — featuring an abstract interactive evolution piece and a blank sketching sheet.

## 刊物目录（中文 Markdown 孪生原稿）
- [第 01 期（FEATURE）：让博客重新成为博客](https://www.esoren.com/posts/let-blogs-be-blogs-again/index.md): 从初中的 Hexo、宝塔面板与 Sakurairo，到今天一页白纸般的原生 HTML 画布——内含抽象交互装置「从框架到白纸」与自由画纸「一页白纸和一支笔」。

## Core Concepts
- **Independent Blogging / 独立博客** (`indie-blog`): The evolution and return of personal corners of the web — from shared hosts and WordPress to frameworkless HTML.
- **Frameworkless Web / 无框架网页** (`frameworkless-web`): Setting down templates and build crutches to let native HTML5 act as a living, breathing canvas.
- **Creation with LLMs / AI 与创造力** (`llm-creation`): How large language models collapse the distance between an idea and its finished form, reshaping personal thought and expression.
- **Personal Aesthetics / 个人审美与表达** (`personal-aesthetics`): Stepping beyond lookalike templates and heirloom CSS so visual style carries personal sensibility and spirit.
- **Open Source & Memory / 开源与时代见证** (`open-source-chronicle`): Preserving every line of code in public commit history as a living witness to how an era thought and built.

## Stream (Recent Fragments)
- [#004 (2026-11-26 · SNIPPET)](https://www.esoren.com/en/stream/#t-004): And this is an even more endless placeholder example. Since we just rolled out this fresh sheet of paper for Stream, might as well slip in a tiny CSS snippet to check whether tabular numerals, code blocks, and cobalt highlights feel nimble in both light and dark ink. / 这更是一个没完没了的占位示例。既然刚刚给刊物铺好「思维」这页新白纸，顺手塞进一段极简 CSS 切片，检验一下等宽序号、代码块和深浅模式下的钴蓝光晕够不够灵动。
- [#003 (2026-11-25 · QUESTION)](https://www.esoren.com/en/stream/#t-003): This is yet another placeholder example. Sometimes a half-baked idea is too small for a numbered `No. XX` issue, yet too good to gather dust in a private notes app — maybe the Stream is simply the seedbed before an essay breaks ground? / 这还是一个占位示例。有时候脑子里刚冒出一个半成品念头，还撑不起一整期 `No. XX` 正式刊号，但丢进私密备忘录又容易吃灰——也许「思维」正是长文破土之前的那块苗圃？
- [#002 (2026-11-23 · QUOTE)](https://www.esoren.com/en/stream/#t-002): This is also an example — demonstrating the typographic cadence of a clipping with margin commentary: editorial serif holding the excerpt aloft, crisp sans below for whatever stray note follows. / 这也是一条示例。用来示范「摘录与旁白」的排印节奏：上面用衬线体安静托住原句，下面留给此刻随口补上的一两句碎碎念。
- [#001 (2026-11-20 · MUSING)](https://www.esoren.com/en/stream/#t-001): This is an example. No boxed cards, no notification badges, and no obligation to stretch a passing thought into two thousand words — just a quiet sheet of paper, a few lines of musing, and room to breathe. / 这是一条示例。没有卡片边框、没有红点角标、也不必非得凑足两千字才配发出来——一页白纸，几行碎碎念，先让这块地方自由呼吸起来。
